feature_weights_status: Untrained heuristic defaults; not the original paper's learned SVM weights.

metric_definitions.coverage_percent: matched observations / input observations * 100. Not accuracy.
metric_definitions.ground_truth_accuracy_percent: Exact selected directed edge match / usable labeled observations * 100. Blank when verified edge labels are unavailable.
metric_definitions.gps_to_road_distance_m: Projected geometric distance from GPS observation to selected edge. A fit proxy, not ground-truth accuracy.
metric_definitions.prediction_delay_observations: For each matched point, number of later observations available when its road prediction was committed. Offline baselines are measured at trajectory end.
metric_definitions.prediction_delay_seconds: Timestamp at commitment minus observation timestamp, when both parse and are ordered.
metric_definitions.invalid_transition_count: Adjacent matched observations with no directed road path from the previous selected edge's downstream node to the next selected edge's upstream node. The naive-HMM model does not enforce this constraint.
metric_definitions.runtime_seconds: Shared candidate preparation time plus the measured decode/selection time for this method.

runtime_definition: Shared candidate preparation time plus the measured decode/selection time for this method.
window_buffer_definition: At arrival t, decode at most the trailing T observations and finalize through t-N; flush the remaining tail at segment end or a candidate-free gap.
